## What's new

- **Cards and background share the same image.** Landscape cards in Continue Playing and All Games show the game's **Background** with its **Logo** on top, the same art as the Home screen background. Portrait cards (Library) show the **Portrait Cover**.
- Landscape covers are no longer downloaded, and the Landscape Cover section is removed from **Edit Artwork**. To change a card, change the game's Background or Logo.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
